subject: Pilot Health renewal: MSA + order form redlines and procurement timeline
messages:
From: Sam Rodgers <sam.rodgers@pilothealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@pilothealth.com
Date: 2028-05-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal proposal and draft MSA redlines

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the renewal estimate — attached is the draft MSA with a few redlines from our side. High level: Pilot Health is comfortable with the proposed capacity uplift (+30%), but procurement needs clarity on term length (we prefer 12 months) and a billing date that aligns with our fiscal quarter.

Key asks from our side:
- Remove the perpetual indemnity language in Section 10.2 (legal flagged).
- Add a 30-day service credit SLAs carve for availability below 99.5%.
- Clarify data retention and logs (we need logs retained for 90 days minimum).

We have an internal deadline: procurement approval by 2028-06-05 to get new seats live for the July onboarding. Attaching the MSA redline and our PO stub.

Attachments: PilotHealth_MSA_redline_v3.docx; PilotHealth_PO-678.pdf

Thanks,
Sam Rodgers
Head of Procurement — Pilot Health
procurement@pilothealth.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Sam Rodgers <sam.rodgers@pilothealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-26T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal and draft MSA redlines

Sam — thanks for the redlines and the clear timeline. Looping in Laura (legal) and Karthik (sales) to align on: term length, the indemnity ask, and SLA credit language.

Quick response to your asks:
- Term: Redwood typically supports 12- and 24-month terms; 12 months is fine but note pricing was built for 18 months — Karthik will provide an updated order form pricing for a 12-month term.
- Indemnity: Laura, can you confirm whether removing the perpetual indemnity is acceptable and propose replacement wording if not?
- SLA credit: We can add an availability credit schedule; need to confirm measurement window and whether 99.5% is measured monthly.
- Data retention: We can commit to 90-day access logs retention for Pilot Health in Hosted accounts; will confirm with infra.

Attached: Redwood_Clean_MSA_20280525.docx (for Laura's baseline). Next steps: Laura to provide markup; Karthik to send reorder pricing. If all aligned, I can prepare a DocuSign packet with the Order Form + MSA clean + redline summary by EOD 05/29.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Lead, Renewals — Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Clean_MSA_20280525.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Sam Rodgers <sam.rodgers@pilothealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-27T09:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal and draft MSA redlines

Sam / Sofia — reviewed Pilot Health redlines. High-level comments below and inline in the attached markup. Please see the attached clean redline + comments.

Summary of legal position:
- Indemnity: We cannot accept a blanket removal of indemnity. Propose narrow language that limits Redwood's continuing obligation to claims arising out of Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct, and carve out standard third-party IP claims. See §10.2 (proposed text in attached).
- Perpetual obligations: We agree to remove language that implies perpetual liability; replace with 2-year survivability for commercial terms and confidentiality, except for IP indemnity which survives as negotiated.
- SLA credit: Accept the 99.5% trigger. Counterproposal: credits capped at 30% of monthly invoice for affected services; measurement window = calendar month; dispute resolution to include 30-day remediation notice before crediting for recurring issues.
- Data retention: We can commit to 90-day logs retention for Hosted accounts; for dedicated/private deployments we'll document scope of logs and any additional fees if extended retention is required.

Procurement notes:
- If Pilot Health needs an earlier invoice date alignment, Finance can issue a pro forma tied to the signature date but we need to confirm whether Pilot wants billing to start on 7/1 — that can be done if the order is executed by 6/30.

Next steps (action owners):
- Laura: finalize MSA redline and provide replacement indemnity text (attached).
- Karthik: produce a 12-month order form showing adjusted pricing for +30% capacity (deadline 05/28 EOD).
- Sofia: assemble DocuSign packet and confirm final sign path once I sign off on wording.

Attachment: Redwood_MSA_markup_20280527.docx

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
Attachment stub: Redwood_MSA_markup_20280527.docx

From: Sam Rodgers <sam.rodgers@pilothealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@pilothealth.com
Date: 2028-05-29T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal and draft MSA redlines

Laura / Sofia — really appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from procurement:
- The capped credit (30% monthly) is acceptable, but Pilot Health needs a written example of how credits would apply if capacity is impacted vs availability. Can you include one worked example in the SOW or an appendix?
- Our procurement team prefers billing to start on July 1 and invoices to be net 45 to match our payment cycles. Is net 45 doable?
- We will sign electronically. Please include a DocuSign flow that routes to me (Sam) then to Erin Lowe (CFO) for final sign-off.

Attached: PilotHealth_PO-678.pdf (PO stub). Expecting final DocuSign packet no later than 2028-05-30 so we can review and return before 06/05.

Thanks,
Sam
procurement@pilothealth.com
Attachments: PilotHealth_PO-678.pdf

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Sam Rodgers <sam.rodgers@pilothealth.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-30T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Final packet and sign path (Pilot Health renewal)

Sam — all aligned. Deliverables attached and next steps below.

Deliverables included in DocuSign packet:
1) Clean MSA (Redwood_MSA_final_20280530.docx) — includes Laura's indemnity language and survivability edits.
2) Order Form (OrderForm_PilotHealth_2028-06.pdf) — Karthik updated pricing for a 12-month term with +30% capacity; shows monthly pro-rated invoice if start date is 07/01.
3) SLA appendix example — worked example of credit calculation (see Section 3.4).
4) Summary of differences and redline PDF for Pilot Health legal team.

Sign path in DocuSign: Sam Rodgers -> Erin Lowe (CFO) -> Sofia (final Redwood witness) -> Laura (legal countersign). If Pilot prefers Erin signs before Sam, we can change, but please confirm.

Billing terms: Finance can accept net 45; confirm PO number on signature and we will invoice per the Order Form start date.

Links: DocuSign packet: https://www.docusign.com/sign?token=abc123-pilothealth
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/7654321

If everything looks good, Sam — please route the packet to Erin and I'll start the sign path. Target: executed by 2028-06-02 to meet your internal review schedule.

Thanks everyone,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Lead, Renewals — Redwood Inference
Attachments: OrderForm_PilotHealth_2028-06.pdf; Redwood_MSA_final_20280530.docx; SLA_Appendix_Example.pdf
